Exercise 3: Synonym Match 
Match the words on the left with their closest meanings on the right. 
A B 
1. Neglect a. Emotional pain or anxiety 
2. Companionship b. Support and attention from others 
3. Understaffing c. Lack of care or attention 
4. Distress d. Shortage of workers 
5. Independence e. Freedom and self-reliance 
 
          Exercise 4: Collocation Practice 
Complete the phrases with the most suitable word: 
1. __________ of care (quality / form / sense) 
2. Financial __________ (load / burden / issue) 
3. Emotional __________ (damage / distress / fear) 
4. Nursing __________ (house / home / hall) 
5. Medical __________ (supervision / observation / guard)
